summary: EfficientNet-B0 is the strongest overall binary baseline in the current project.
ResNet18 remains the most recall-oriented model, but EfficientNet-B0 offers a stronger overall balance with fewer false positives.
Grad-CAM for EfficientNet-B0 is generally retinal-centered and more clinically plausible than the scratch model, but some artifact sensitivity remains.
EfficientNet-B4 did not outperform EfficientNet-B0 in this setup, showing that a larger backbone is not automatically better.
